rule: game-lines desk probability + passing desk verdict + DraftKings price, pre-game only
note: No pre-game alerts: an alert needs a game-lines-desk probability whose verdict passed (not NO EDGE / UNPROVEN) and a DraftKings price. NBA: 7 desk verdict NO EDGE; NHL: 5 desk verdict NO EDGE; WNBA: 1 not pre-game; MLS: 15 not pre-game; EPL: 4 not pre-game; UCL: 9 not pre-game; NFL: 7 started or no start time; NCAAF: 16 not pre-game; NCAAB: 2 not pre-game; CWS: 1 not pre-game
